description: Create temp doc, add/rename/reorder layers, verify names/order, cleanup
source: var d = app.documents.add(); try { var l1 = d.layers.add(); l1.name = 'alpha'; var l2 = d.layers.add(); l2.name = 'beta'; l2.move(l1, ElementPlacement.PLACEAFTER); var names=[]; for (var i=0;i<d.layers.length;i++){ names.push(d.layers[i].name); } return {count: d.layers.length, names: names}; } finally { try { d.close(SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES); } catch(e){} }
